The loop now covers matrix assembly only: signal component updates, carrier connector scaling, conjugation and noise-matrix update, run per frequency. The stacked matrices then go into the unchanged full-vmap solve and noise section. Candidate 5 (7e00e16b, default None) is validated. It passed official and strict, physical outputs were exact, and the gradient's maximum absolute error was 4.547e-13, the same as the parent's. First run was 24.815 s (parent 24.657), warm median 14.08 s, RSS 12.55 GB. That confirms the refactor and the operator's default are strict-safe, and that the drift in candidates 1–4 comes from running solves inside the loop. Nothing was run locally.
